audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose treated Akshan as a melee bruiser ('trade at his melee range') when he is a ranged marksman.
audit.why: Avengerang is an 850-range boomerang on 9/8/7/6/5s that damages going out and coming back; his Q range beats your Q (700) and W (600).
audit.corrected: The don't now reads as a range warning, not a melee one.

audit.why: LeBlanc spikes at 2, 6 (Mimic 45/35/25s) and first item; Akshan at 6 with Comeuppance (100/85/70s, 2500 range, missing-health damage) and again on attack-speed/crit items.
audit.corrected: Kept; Comeuppance's cooldown and its stop-on-first-target behaviour added to the cooldowns field.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: your Chains reveal him out of Going Rogue's camouflage, and Dirty Fighting shields him on every third hit, eating the sigil detonation.
audit.why: Ethereal Chains carries revealsStealth; Riot's Dirty Fighting text grants a shield when the third hit lands on a champion. Heroic Swing also needs terrain to anchor and is knocked off on champion or terrain collision, so chaining him mid-swing ends the arc.
audit.corrected: Reveal folded into breakdown.carry, shield into dontsFull[2].d, swing collision into dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flagged no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digits.
audit.why: Heroic Swing 18s at rank 1 down to 12s; Avengerang 9s down to 5s; Comeuppance 100/85/70s; your Distortion 15s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with all four numbers and a wait-for-X instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[1..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[1..5] read LeBlanc and win[6] read Akshan; only row 0 agreed.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Skill, LeBlanc x5, Akshan). The full layer is the outlier, and phases[6].why described LeBlanc winning a row the other layer gives to Akshan.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 aligned to the content layer as one atomic group; phases[6].why rewritten to the Akshan verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advised anti-heal 'into his sustain'; Riot's Akshan text contains no heal.
audit.why: Dirty Fighting grants a shield, not healing, so Grievous Wounds is not the answer named.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Distortion (return) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5, and it needs terrain — step up while it is down. - Avengerang is 9s at rank 1, 5s at rank 5. - Comeuppance is 100/85/70s and stops on the first minion. - Your Distortion is 15s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: Heroic Swing anchors to terrain and breaks on champion collision — chain him mid-swing and the arc ends early.

edits.before: Akshan spends Heroic Swing early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Mimic Distortion is your exit at 45/35/25s — bank it for the swing that lands on you.

edits.before: Trade at his melee range pre-items
That’s Akshan’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Akshan is ranged with 850 on Avengerang — melee range is his, not yours.

edits.before: Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit — force that proc out before your burst or it eats the sigil.

edits.before: Carry through picks — one chained carry per objective; your job is the flank angle and the discipline to leave after.
edits.after: Carry through picks — Ethereal Chains reveals him out of Going Rogue, so sweep the fog, chain him, and leave on the return.

edits.before: W-poke the wave contacts and return before his answer — distortion math is the whole champion.
edits.after: W-poke the contacts and return before Avengerang comes back — Distortion math is the whole champion.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Stormsurge or Luden's, Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Spend gold like the lead expires — it does. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Stormsurge or Luden's, Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Spend gold like the lead expires — it does. Add Zhonya's against his Comeuppance.

edits.before: Late LeBlanc picks: W the flank, chain the carry, mimic the exit — and vanish before the obituary prints.
edits.after: Akshan's autos and Comeuppance chip you from 2500 range; your one burst window has to kill or you lose.
